features_finance.subheading: Uhereye kuri Mobile Money kugeza ku bushishozi bwa CFO — amafaranga yawe agaragara mu buryo bwuzuye.
features_finance.meta_description: Kurikira ubwishyu n'imiterere y'imari ukoresheje CFO Dashboard, CEO Dashboard, kugenzura mu gihe nyacyo no guhuza amakuru.

hero.title: CFO Dashboard
hero.desc: Imiterere y'imari, ubushishozi ku nyungu, na metrics za subscription — hamwe n'isesengura rya AI. Byihuta cyane (<1s).

featured.title: CEO Dashboard
featured.desc: Imiterere y'ubucuruzi, inyungu, abakiriya n'imikorere — byose hamwe. Bivugururwa buri minota 5.

payout_summary.title: Incamake y'ubwishyu (Payout)
payout_summary.desc: Reba amafaranga yose yinjiye (Brut), komisiyo, n'asigaye (Net) kuri buri gacuruzwa. Ushobora no guhitamo igihe ushaka kurebaho.

payment_monitor.title: Kugenzura ubwishyu
payment_monitor.desc: Kurikirana ubwishyu mu gihe nyacyo no gusesengura uburyo bwo kwishyura.

transactions.title: Transaksiyo
transactions.desc: Reba urutonde rwose rwa transaksiyo, ushungure kandi usohore raporo.

features_growth.subheading: Imikorere ni intangiriro gusa. Imboni Serve igufasha kubona no kugumana abakiriya.
features_growth.meta_description: Kubona no kugumana abakiriya ukoresheje Discovery, ubukangurambaga bwa WhatsApp, Site Builder n'ibikoresho byo gucunga ibikubiyemo.

hero.title: Kugaragara kuri Discovery
hero.desc: Garagara aho abakiriya bashakira ubucuruzi bwo kwakira abakiriya hafi yabo. Erekana amoko y'ibiribwa, ibiciro n'aho uherereye.

whatsapp_campaigns.title: Kwamamaza kuri WhatsApp
whatsapp_campaigns.desc: Ohereza ubutumwa bugenewe ibyiciro bya CRM — Champions, Abari mu kaga, Bashya — kuri WhatsApp. Ubutumwa bwihariye n'ikurikirana.

site_builder.title: Site Builder
site_builder.desc: Wubake urubuga rwawe ukoresheje AI. Hitamo template, wongereho umwimerere wa brand yawe maze ushyire ku murongo mu klik imwe.

marketer_dashboard.title: Dashboard ya Marketer
marketer_dashboard.desc: Cunga abafatanyabikorwa, komisiyo, ubwishyu n'amakarita ya QR. Kurikirana ibikorwa kandi uhemba abashyigikira.

content_management_cms.title: Gucunga ibikubiyemo (CMS)
content_management_cms.desc: Ohereza inyandiko n'amashusho kuri Discovery kandi ucunge ibikubiyemo byose ahantu hamwe.

video_analytics.title: Isesengura rya Video
video_analytics.desc: Reba uko amashusho yakiriwe: umubare w'abayarebye, igihe cyo kuyareba n'ubwitabire.

features_infrastructure.subheading: Urufatiro rutuma ibindi byose bikora neza.
features_infrastructure.meta_description: Gucunga abakozi, ububiko, Contacts, umutekano n'amenyesha — byose bigize urufatiro rw'ubucuruzi bwawe.

staff_management.title: Gucunga abakozi
staff_management.desc: CRUD yuzuye hamwe n'inshingano za sisitemu, uburenganzira n'igenwa ry'amashami. Genzura uruhushya rwa waiter, cashier, supervisor, manager n'abandi.

inventory_management.title: Gucunga ububiko
inventory_management.desc: Kurikirana ububiko, aho wongera gutumiza, ibiciro n'amatsinda y'ibicuruzwa. Bika amateka y'impinduka zose.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.desc: Cunga Contacts zawe ahantu hamwe. Kurikirana abatanga ibikoresho, abakiriya n'abafatanyabikorwa.

security_sessions.title: Umutekano & Sessions
security_sessions.desc: Kurikirana sessions zikora, MFA, ibikorwa by'umutekano no gufunga sessions.

notifications_settings.title: Igenamiterere ry'amenyesha
notifications_settings.desc: Gena raporo za buri munsi, alerts za WhatsApp na timezone.

features_analytics.h1: Sobanukirwa Ubucuruzi Bwawe Mu buryo Burambuye
features_analytics.subheading: Analytics iguha amakuru afasha gufata ibyemezo byiza, aho kureba imibare gusa.
features_analytics.meta_description: Business Analytics, Menu Analytics n'Analytics z'inyungu zifashwa na AI, hamwe na Dashboards zihuta n'igenzura rikora ryikora.

cfo_dashboard.title: CFO Dashboard
cfo_dashboard.desc: Kurikirana imikorere y'imari, inyungu, subscriptions n'isesengura rya AI byose muri Dashboard imwe. Amakuru agaragara mu gihe kitarenze isegonda rimwe.

ceo_dashboard.title: CEO Dashboard
ceo_dashboard.desc: Reba muri Dashboard imwe imikorere y'ubucuruzi, inyungu, abakiriya n'ibikorwa byose, bikusanyijwe mu buryo bwikora kandi bivugururwa buri minota 5.

crm_with_rfm_segmentation.title: CRM with RFM Segmentation
crm_with_rfm_segmentation.desc: Tandukanya abakiriya mu byiciro nka Champions, Loyal, At Risk, Lost, New na Potential kugira ngo ubashe kubagezaho serivisi n'ubukangurambaga bubakwiriye.

qr_analytics.title: QR Analytics
qr_analytics.desc: Kurikirana uko QR Code zisikanwa n'uko zihinduka kugurisha kugira ngo umenye izikora neza kurusha izindi.

menu_performance_analytics.title: Menu Performance Analytics
menu_performance_analytics.desc: Reba amafaranga yinjira n'ibyagurishijwe kuri buri gicuruzwa kugira ngo umenye ibigenda neza n'ibigomba kunozwa.

peak_hours_analytics.title: Peak Hours Analytics
peak_hours_analytics.desc: Menya amasaha n'iminsi ubucuruzi bwawe buba bwuzuye cyane kugira ngo utegure neza abakozi n'ibikorwa.

instruction_insights.title: Instruction Insights
instruction_insights.desc: Sobanukirwa ibyifuzo n'amabwiriza by'abakiriya kugira ngo urusheho kubaha serivisi nziza.

video_analytics.title: Video Analytics
video_analytics.desc: Kurikirana Views, igihe abantu bamara bareba n'uburyo bitabira Video zawe.

payment_monitor.title: Kugenzura ubwishyu
payment_monitor.desc: Gukurikirana ubwishyu mu gihe nyacyo, n'isesengura ry'imikorere y'uburyo bwo kwishyura.

transactions.title: Transaksiyo
transactions.desc: Urutonde rwose rwa transaksiyo, n'ubushobozi bwo kuyungurura no kohereza hanze.

marketplace.store_subtitle: Shakisha abatanga ibikoresho n'ibicuruzwa byiza ku bucuruzi bwawe

discovery.subtitle: Vumburwa binyuze muri Discovery ya Imboni. Abakiriya bashakisha ubucuruzi bwo kwakira abakiriya barakubona, bakareba ibyo utanga kandi bagatumiza ako kanya.

qrBuilder.title: QR Menu Builder
qrBuilder.subtitle: Kora Design ya QR ifite umwimerere wa brand yawe mu minota mike. Hitamo Template, hindura ibisabwa bike, ubike hanyuma uyimanure.
qrBuilder.deleteConfirm: Gusiba iyi Design ya QR? Ntibishobora gusubizwa inyuma.

features.title: Platform imwe. Imikorere yose.
features.subtitle: Cungira ubucuruzi bwawe bwose bwo kwakira abakiriya muri Platform imwe ifite ubwenge — komande, ububiko, ubwishyu, ubushishozi n'iterambere.
features.qr_ordering_desc: Abakiriya basikana QR Code, bakareba Menu kandi bagatanga komande bakoresheje telefoni zabo — nta App ikenewe.
features.inventory_desc: Kurikirana ububiko, shyiraho igihe cyo kongera gutumiza kandi ucunge Purchase Orders hamwe n'amateka yuzuye.
features.reports_desc: Raporo za buri munsi, buri cyumweru na buri kwezi. Menya inyungu, ibyakoreshejwe n'umusaruro mu kanya gato.
features.ai_insights_desc: Inama z'ubwenge zo kongera gutumiza n'alerts ku biciro bidasanzwe kugira ngo urinde inyungu zawe.
features.discovery_feed_desc: Sangiza abakiriya inyandiko, Promotions n'amafoto. Bafashe kukubona no gutanga komande bahereye kuri Feed yawe.
features.smart_slips_desc: Inyemezabwishyu za Digital zikozwe mu buryo bwikora, zigaragaza ibisobanuro byose hamwe n'ibihembo byo kohereza abandi kuri WhatsApp.
features.loyalty_desc: Kubaka ubudahemuka bw'abakiriya ukoresheje amanota, ibyiciro n'igenzura ry'ibihembo.
features.promotions_desc: Shyiraho Promotions z'igihe runaka n'amapaki yihariye atangira kandi akarangira mu buryo bwikora.
features.whatsapp_desc: Akira Alerts za komande, incamake za buri munsi n'amenyesha y'ububiko buke kuri WhatsApp.
features.mobile_money_desc: Akira ubwishyu bwa Mobile Money ako kanya — nta POS Terminal ikenewe.
features.multi_branch_desc: Cunga amashami menshi muri Dashboard imwe hamwe na raporo rusange cyangwa iz'ishami rimwe.
features.roles_desc: Ushinzwe kashi, umuseriveri, umugenzuzi n'umucungamutungo — buri wese abona ibyo yemerewe gusa.

advanced.title: Yubakiwe Iterambere
advanced.subtitle: Ibyo ukeneye byose kugira ngo ukure uva ku ishami rimwe ujye ku bucuruzi bugezweho bwo kwakira abakiriya—byose muri platforme imwe y'ubwenge.
advanced.hotel_mode_desc: Imicungire y’icyumba, serivisi n’ahakirwa abakiriya ku bucuruzi bwo kwakira abakiriya.
advanced.site_builder_desc: Tangiza urubuga rwawe (website) ukoresheje templates zihindurwa uko ushaka — nta bumenyi bwa coding bukenewe.
advanced.ai_menu_desc: Hindura menu yawe igere ku rwego rwa digital mu minota mike. Ohereza ifoto cyangwa inyandiko, AI ikore menu y'umwuga yiteguye gutumizwaho.
advanced.marketplace_desc: Fasha abakiriya benshi kuvumbura ubucuruzi bwawe binyuze muri ecosystem ya Imboni, hamwe na profile zishakishwa, promotions, n'ukugaragara kuri digital.
advanced.procurement_desc: Cunga ibyo ugura, abagurisha, ibiri mu bubiko, n'igiciro cy'ibiryo mu buryo bugaragara neza kuva ku kwakira ibicuruzwa kugeza ku mikoreshereze.
advanced.referral_desc: Sangiza, winjize — Abakiriya batumira inshuti zabo bagahita babona ibihembo mu buryo bwikora.
advanced.staff_desc: Genzura uwo wemerewe kugera ku ki ukoresheje inshingano n'uburenganzira byoroshye kuri buri mukozi wawe.
advanced.multi_branch_desc: Cunga amashami menshi ukoresheje platforme imwe, raporo zihuriweho, ukugaragara kw'ububiko, n'imikorere ihamye.
advanced.business_intelligence_desc: Kurikirana igurisha, imyitwarire y'abakiriya, ububiko, n'uko imari ihagaze ukoresheje insights z'igihe nyacyo zigufasha gufata ibyemezo byiza.
advanced.service_replay_desc: Subiza inyuma urebe buri gikorwa cyose cyabaye muri serivisi maze umenye neza icyagenze n'icyo ugomba kunoza.
advanced.inventory_alerts: Imenyesha ry'Ububiko Buke & Gutumiza mu Buryo Bwikora
advanced.inventory_alerts_desc: Menyeshwa igihe ububiko buri hafi gushira, AI igufashe no gutegura ibyo ugomba gutumiza ku baguha ibicuruzwa.
advanced.smart_slips_desc: Hita ukora inyemezabwishyu za digitale ushobora gusangiza umukiriya kugira ngo arusheho guhabwa serivisi nziza.

discovery.title: Fasha abakiriya kuvumbura ubucuruzi bwawe
discovery.subtitle: Vumburwa binyuze muri ecosystem ya Imboni. Abakiriya bashakisha ubucuruzi bwo kwakira abakiriya barakubona, bakareba ibyo utanga, kandi bagatumiza ako kanya.

payments.title: Emera uburyo bwo kwishyura abakiriya bawe bakoresha
payments.subtitle: Uburyo bwo kwishyura buhindurwa bitewe n'isoko ryawe — mobile money, amakarita, cash, na digital wallets.

final_cta.title: Witeguye guhindura imikorere y'ubucuruzi bwawe?
final_cta.subtitle: Tangira igerageza ry'ubuntu ry'iminsi 14 uyu munsi — nta karita y'inguzanyo ikenewe. Gerageza Operating System for Hospitality.

footer.copyright: Imboni Serve. Yubakiwe ubucuruzi bwo kwakira abakiriya.

how_it_works.title: Uko Bikorwa
how_it_works.subtitle: Intambwe 6 zoroshye zo kujyana ubucuruzi bwawe mu ikoranabuhanga no gutangira gutanga serivisi mu buryo buhanitse
how_it_works.step1_desc: Iyandikishe mu minota 2. Uzuza izina ry'ubucuruzi bwawe, ahantu ukorera, n'amakuru ya nyir'ubucuruzi, Ubone ikibaho (dashboard) cyawe mu kanya nkako guhumbya.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Ongeraho ibiryo n'ibinyobwa hamwe n'amafoto, ibiciro n'ibisobanuro. Koresha AI Menu Builder kugira ngo Ushyireho ifoto cyangwa PDF maze menu yawe ikorwe ako kanya.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Shyiraho ameza yawe (Table 1, VIP Section, Terrace, n’ibindi) kandi ukore QR (Impishabanga shusho) zidasanzwe kuri buri meza — byose ubikoreye kuri dashboard yawe. Zicapishe uzishyire ku meza.
how_it_works.step4_desc: Huza nimero yawe ya WhatsApp kugira ngo ubone ubutumwa bwa komande ako kanya na raporo za buri munsi. Emera uburyo bwo kwishyura uhitamo kugira ngo kwishyura byorohe.
how_it_works.step5_desc: Ongeraho ibicuruzwa byo mu bubiko, shyiraho aho wongera kubitumiza, kandi ukurikirane buri gikorwa cyo kugura. Bona iburira rya AI igihe ibiciro byiyongereye cyangwa ububiko bugiye gushira.
how_it_works.step6_desc: Abakiriya basikana kode za QR bagakora komande, igikoni kigahita kibona imenyesha, kandi ubwishyu bugakorwa mu buryo bwikora. Kurikirana imibare y’ubucuruzi, tegura promo, kandi wagure ubucuruzi bwawe nta mpungenge.
how_it_works.cta_subtitle: Kora konti yawe — bifata iminota 2 gusa!

rt.title: Buri uko ugurishije. Buri Meza. Ibikorwa Byose — Mu Gihe Nyacyo
rt.sales_desc: Reba amafaranga winjiza mu gihe nyacyo, kandi uhite ufata ibyemezo ako kanya.
rt.qr_desc: Menya ni iyihe meza cyangwa QR izana komande nyinshi n'inyungu nyinshi.
rt.tables_desc: Menya uko ameza ahagaze — ari gukoreshwa, ategereje, cyangwa adakoreshwa — mu gihe nyacyo.
rt.peak_desc: Tegura abakozi ukurikije uko abakiriya bakugana mu masaha atandukanye y’umunsi.

growth.title: Wongera Inyungu ku Buryo Bwikora
growth.crm_desc: Shyira abakiriya mu byiciro by’Indashyikirwa, Abizerwa, n’abo ushobora gutakaza.
growth.campaigns_title: Kwamamaza kuri WhatsApp mu buryo bwikora
growth.campaigns_desc: Ohereza ubutumwa bugenewe buri cyiciro cy’abakiriya ku giti cyabo.
growth.ab_desc: Gerageza ibiciro, inyandiko, n'amashusho. Hitamo ibyiza ushingiye ku makuru..
growth.voice_desc: Reka abakiriya batumize bakoresheje ijwi mu Cyongereza / Igifaransa / Ikinyarwanda.
growth.alerts_desc: Ntuzigere ubura ibicuruzwa. Akira iburira mbere y’uko bigera ku musozo.

growth.resv_desc: Gabanya abadafata rezerivasiyo ukoresheje kubitsa no kwemeza rezerivasiyo mu buryo bwikora.

why_switch.title: Nturi kubona gusa POS. Uhabwa Ubwenge.
why_switch.subtitle: Ubushobozi bukemura ibibazo abandi birengagiza.
why_switch.replay_desc: Subiramo igihe cy'akazi nk'umukino. Buri komande, buri poste, buri meza — uko byakurikiranye.
why_switch.crm_desc: Tandukanya abakiriya: Abahize, Ab'indahemuka, n'Abari mu kaga.
why_switch.ab_desc: Gerageza ibiciro, amagambo n'amafoto. Hitamo ibihesha umusaruro ukoresheje amakuru.

why_ai.title: AI si ijambo rigezweho gusa. Irimo gukora ubu kuri dashboard yawe.
why_ai.subtitle: AI ikora akazi nyako — atari ukwerekana gusa imibare.
why_ai.menu_builder_desc: Ohereza ifoto cyangwa PDF ya menu. AI isohora ibyo kurya, ibiciro n'ibisobanuro.
why_ai.auto_reorder_desc: Isesengura ibisabwa, igihe cyo gutanga n'ububiko bw'umutekano igatanga inama zo gusubizamo.
why_ai.insight_reports_desc: Raporo za buri cyumweru na buri kwezi zifite KPI, isesengura ryanditse n'iby'ingenzi byo gushyira imbere.
why_ai.cost_anomaly_desc: Kumenya ku buryo bwikora izamuka ry'ibiciro by'abagurisha hakoreshejwe statistiki.

why_trust.title: Si POS isanzwe ifite amashusho meza. Ni ubwenge ku rwego rw'ibigo.
why_trust.subtitle: Byubakiwe abayobozi, atari abakira amategeko gusa.
why_trust.cfo_desc: Imiterere y'imari, ubwenge bw'inyungu, metrics z'ubusabe — hamwe n'inyandiko za AI n'isesengura ry'ihuzwa.
why_trust.ceo_desc: Imiterere y'ubucuruzi, inyungu, abakiriya, imikorere n'iby'ubukerarugendo — byegeranyijwe mu buryo bwikora.

why_now.title: Buri munsi udafite ubwenge ni umunsi w'inyungu zitakaye.
why_now.stockouts: Kubura ububiko bituma utakaza abakiriya. AI ibikumira mbere y'igihe.
why_now.pricing: Uri gushyiraho ibiciro uhumye. Gerageza ibiciro ukoresheje amakuru y'ukuri.
why_now.churn: Ntumenya ugiye kureka kugura. RFM irabigaragaza mu buryo bwikora.
why_now.supplier: Abagurisha bazamura ibiciro bucece. Iburira ry'ibiciro ribifata kare.
why_now.replay: Ntushobora kumenya neza ibyabaye ijoro ryashize. Service Replay™ isubiramo buri kintu.

founding_program.title: Founding Hospitality Business Program
founding_program.subtitle: Ba umwe mu bucuruzi 100 bwa mbere buzagira uruhare mu kubaka ejo hazaza h'ikoranabuhanga rifasha ubwakiranyi.
founding_program.benefit_1_desc: Uzahora wishyura kimwe cya kabiri cy'igiciro cya gahunda yawe igihe cyose uzakomeza gukoresha Imboni Serve. Nta gihe ntarengwa.
founding_program.benefit_2_title: Ubufasha Buturutse ku Bashinze Imboni Serve
founding_program.benefit_2_desc: Habwa ubufasha bwihariye bwo gutangira gukoresha Imboni Serve ndetse unabashe kuvugana n'abayishinze igihe ubikeneye.
founding_program.benefit_3_desc: Ba mu ba mbere bakoresha features nshya n'ibindi bishya bya Imboni Serve mbere y'abandi.
founding_program.benefit_4_title: Gira Uruhare mu Guteza Imbere Platform
founding_program.benefit_4_desc: Ibitekerezo byawe n'ibyo ukeneye mu bucuruzi bwawe bizadufasha kugena ibyo tuzashyira muri Platform mu gihe kiri imbere.

pricing_preview.heading: Ibiciro Bijyanye n'Ingano y'Ubucuruzi Bwawe

faq.heading: Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa
faq.subtitle: Kwishyura, Amafaranga ya Serivisi n'Amabwiriza ya Platform

contact.heading: Ufite ikindi kibazo?
contact.body: Itsinda ryacu ryo kugufasha rihora ryiteguye kugufasha. Twandikire igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
contact.hours_value: Kuwa Mbere – Ku Cyumweru, 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM

0.q: Kuki hari amafaranga ya serivisi ku kwishyura hakoreshejwe Platform?
0.a: Amafaranga ya serivisi ya 5% afasha gutunganya ubwishyu, kurinda uburiganya, kwemeza ubwishyu bwihuse no gutuma ibikorwa byose bikora neza. Iyo wishyuye mu mafaranga (Cash), nta mafaranga ya serivisi acibwa.

1.a: Kwishyura mu mafaranga (Cash) ntibigira amafaranga ya serivisi. Amafaranga ya serivisi akoreshwa gusa ku kwishyura hakoreshejwe ikarita cyangwa Mobile Money.

2.q: Ni ayahe mafaranga make n'ayahe menshi ya serivisi?
2.a: Amafaranga make ya serivisi ni RWF 100, naho menshi ni RWF 3,500. N'iyo itumizwa ryaba rinini gute, amafaranga ya serivisi ntazigera arenza RWF 3,500.

3.q: Ese inama (Tips) zibarwa mu mafaranga ya serivisi?
3.a: Oya. Tips ntizibarwa mu mafaranga ya serivisi. Amafaranga abarwa gusa ku biryo n'ibinyobwa byatumijwe.

4.q: Ese TVA iba irimo mu mafaranga ya serivisi?
4.a: Yego. Amafaranga ya serivisi agaragazwa harimo TVA, bityo nta yandi mafaranga yihishe wongerwa igihe wishyura.

5.q: Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kwishyura bucibwa amafaranga ya serivisi?
5.a: Amafaranga ya serivisi akoreshwa ku kwishyura hakoreshejwe Visa, Mastercard na Mobile Money. Kwishyura mu mafaranga (Cash) cyangwa kohereza kuri banki ntibicibwa amafaranga ya serivisi.

6.a: Ku bicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi bicuruzwa binyuze kuri Marketplace, komisiyo ni 10% + TVA ku bacuruzi bashya, 7% + TVA ku basanzwe, na 5% + TVA ku bacuruzi bafite ibicuruzwa byinshi (barenga RWF 5M ku kwezi).

7.a: Yego. Kwishyura kose gutanga inyemezabuguzi ya EBM igaragaza ibisobanuro byose by'ubwishyu, harimo amafaranga ya serivisi (niba ahari), TVA n'umubare wishyuwe.

8.q: Nakora iki niba ntekereza ko naciwe amafaranga atari yo?
8.a: Hamagara itsinda ryacu ryo kugufasha ukoresheje support@imboni.resto cyangwa +250 788 917 126. Tuzasuzuma ikibazo cyawe kandi tugisubize mu masaha 24–48.

9.q: Ese amafaranga ya serivisi ashobora guhinduka?
9.a: Yego. Mu gihe amafaranga ya serivisi ahindutse, tuzabimenyesha nibura iminsi 30 mbere binyuze kuri email no kuri Platform.

qr_builder_extended.instruction_1: Hitamo Template iri ibumoso. Iyi tool ikora QR Code Posters cyangwa amakarita ushobora gucapa cyangwa gusangiza abandi.
qr_builder_extended.instruction_2: Hitamo Ubwoko bwa QR Code (Imeza, Ishami, Gutumiza Mbere cyangwa Takeaway). Niba ari Imeza, hitamo imeza ushaka ko ihuzwa na QR Code.
qr_builder_extended.instruction_3: Hindura amabara, ubutumwa na Logo / Image URL (bitari ngombwa). Menu n'ibiyigize bicungirwa ahandi muri Dashboard → Menu.
qr_builder_extended.instruction_4: Niba ubishaka, banza ubike Design yawe, hanyuma Download PNG cyangwa SVG kugira ngo uyicape cyangwa uyisangize.
qr_builder_extended.note_menu_managed_elsewhere: Icyitonderwa: Aha ntuhakorera Menu yawe. Aha hakorerwa gusa Designs zihuza Menu yawe isanzwe.
qr_builder_extended.tip_templates_support_images: Inama: Templates zimwe zemera amashusho. Shyira Logo / Image URL kugira ngo wongereho ikirango cyawe.
qr_builder_extended.no_tables_found: Nta meza zabonetse. Banza ukore imeza.
qr_builder_extended.logo_optional_note: Si ngombwa. Ikoreshwa gusa na Templates zishyigikira amashusho.
qr_builder_extended.embed_warning: Hitamo ishusho hanyuma ukande iyi buto kugira ngo uyinjize muri QR Code.
qr_builder_extended.no_qr_codes_desc: Kora QR Code yawe ya mbere uhitamo Template hanyuma ukande "Bika Design".

refer.meta_description: Sangiza inshuti zawe Imboni Serve. Iyo zimaze gukora komande yujuje ibisabwa, mwembi muhabwa 1,000 RWF. Nta mipaka, nta makuru y'ubwishyu asabwa.
refer.subtitle: Sangiza inshuti zawe Imboni Serve. Iyo zimaze gukora komande yujuje ibisabwa, mwembi muhabwa 1,000 RWF. Nta mipaka, nta makuru y'ubwishyu asabwa — uhembwa ako kanya!

steps.1_desc: Injiza nimero ya telefoni yawe kugira ngo ubone kode yawe yihariye yo gutumira abandi.
steps.2_desc: Inshuti yawe ikoreshe urubuga cyangwa kode yawe maze ikore komande.
steps.3_desc: Komande ya mbere igomba kuba nibura 5,000 RWF.

refer.requirements_desc: Inshuti yawe igomba kurangiza komande yayo ya mbere nibura ya 5,000 RWF. Ni ibyo gusa.

refer.share_code_desc: Sangiza iyi kode abandi bashobora gukoresha Imboni Serve.
refer.welcome_bonus_desc: Iyo inshuti yawe irangije komande yayo ya mbere, mwembi muhabwa 1,000 RWF.
refer.unlimited_desc: Nta mubare ntarengwa wo gutumira. Uko utumira benshi, ni ko ibihembo byawe byiyongera.
refer.fast_payout_desc: Ibihembo byawe biboneka nyuma y'iminsi 7 yo kugenzura. Ushobora kubyakira kuri Mobile Money cyangwa kubikoresha muri Imboni Serve.
refer.step1_desc: Ohereza urubuga rwawe rwo gutumira ukoresheje WhatsApp, SMS cyangwa imbuga nkoranyambaga.
refer.step2_desc: Inshuti yawe ikoreshe urubuga rwawe maze ikore komande yayo ya mbere nibura ya 5,000 RWF.
refer.step3_desc: 1,000 RWF zishyirwa kuri konti ya buri wese nyuma y'iminsi 7 yo kugenzura.
refer.redeem_dine_desc: Koresha amafaranga yawe wishyure muri resitora zikoresha Imboni Serve.
refer.redeem_cash_desc: Ohereza amafaranga kuri MTN MoMo cyangwa Airtel Money nyuma yo kwemeza konti yawe.
refer.redeem_cash_list_2: Konti igomba kuba imaze nibura iminsi 30.
refer.terms_validation: Ibihembo bitangwa nyuma y'iminsi 7 yo kugenzura komande.
refer.terms_min_order: Komande ya mbere igomba kuba nibura 5,000 RWF.
refer.terms_one_time: 1,000 RWF zitangwa rimwe kuri buri nshuti.
refer.terms_withdrawal: Kubikuza kuri Mobile Money bisaba nibura 10,000 RWF.
refer.affiliate_desc: Niba ushaka kuzanira Imboni Serve abakiriya b'ubucuruzi ukabona komisiyo ya 15% buri kwezi, ushobora kwinjira muri porogaramu y'abafatanyabikorwa.
